svg.text: PG-1 wiring 8/10: PCF8574 board -> carrier board and the expansion bay
The 4 input pins go to the board's 'expansion' header; the 4 pass-through pins go to the bay in the left wall. The PCF8574 board sits on the
expansion bay (left wall): 4 glued jumper ends
Steps (the number is on the wire)
PCF8574: 'VCC' on the INPUT pins (left end) ->
PCF8574: 'GND' on the INPUT pins (left end) ->
PCF8574: 'SDA' on the INPUT pins (left end) ->
PCF8574: 'SCL' on the INPUT pins (left end) ->
PCF8574: 'VCC' on the PASS-THROUGH pins (right end) ->
jumper, its far end glued in the bay
PCF8574: 'GND' on the PASS-THROUGH pins (right end) ->
jumper, its far end glued in the bay
PCF8574: 'SDA' on the PASS-THROUGH pins (right end) ->
jumper, its far end glued in the bay
PCF8574: 'SCL' on the PASS-THROUGH pins (right end) ->
jumper, its far end glued in the bay
